str.text: The system sensed a voltage of %1 which is too low when enabling an open circuit. The open circuit voltage should be more than %2.
str.desc: Power supply voltage too low when enabling open circuit. %1 = arc voltage. %2 = open circuit voltage.

str.text: The system sensed a voltage of %1 which is too high when enabling a short circuit. The short circuit voltage should be less than %2.
str.desc: Power supply voltage too high when enabling short circuit. %1 = arc voltage. %2 = short circuit voltage.

str.text: The arc start was aborted.
str.desc: Error occurred when starting arc.

str.text: There was an error when servicing the arc. Please check trace-logs for more details.
str.desc: Error occurred when servicing the arc.

str.text: Unable to establish an arc within %1 ms.
str.desc: Unable to establish arc within specified time frame. %1 = timeout time (ms).

str.text: Arc out.
str.desc: Arc was established and then stopped unexpectedly.

str.text: Arclink failed to initialize.
str.desc: Error occurred when initializing power supply

str.text: Power Wave is not ready.
str.desc: Could not start arc because Power Wave was not ready

str.text: Wire feeder start sequence failed.
str.desc: Error occurred when starting wire feeder sequence

str.text: Pilot Arc timeout.
str.desc: Pilot Arc took too long to strike

str.text: The arc type specified in the schedule (%1) is unknown or incompatible with the system.
str.desc: %1 = the arc type specified in the schedule. The arc type specified in the loaded schedule cannot strike on the system.

str.text: The Pilot Arc is currently not enabled. Do you want to enable the Pilot Arc?
str.desc: Pilot arc is not enabled when starting a weld. The user has the option to enable it.

str.text: Pilot Arc out.
str.desc: Pilot Arc was established and then stopped unexpectedly.

str.text: A critical fault has been detected, the system may require service. Amperage telemetry of %1 was not within the allowable range of set point %2. A user with an ADMIN or TECHNICIAN security level may login and diagnose the issue.
str.desc: Amperage telemetry went out of allowable range. Critical fault has occurred. %1 = amperage telemetry %2 = amperage set point

str.text: A critical fault has been detected, the system may require service. Voltage telemetry of %1 was not within the allowable range of set point %2. A user with an ADMIN or TECHNICIAN security level may login and diagnose the issue.
str.desc: Voltage telemetry went out of allowable range. Critical fault has occurred. %1 = voltage telemetry %2 = voltage set point

str.text: A critical fault has been detected, the system may require service. The system has detected an imbalance between the power supply modules. A user with an ADMIN or TECHNICIAN security level may login and diagnose the issue.
str.desc: System has detected an imbalance between power supply modules. Critical fault has occurred.

str.text: All critical faults have been cleared.
str.desc: All critical faults have been cleared.

str.text: Use caution, critical fault is active.
str.desc: Use caution, critical fault is active.

str.text: Verify that all connections are made according to the system connection diagrams prior to arc initiation. Failure to do so could result in a serious shock. Press %1 to enable the pilot arc.
str.desc: Warning when enabling the pilot arc. %1 = name of button to enable the pilot arc.

str.text: A critical Input Power fault has been detected on POWER MONITOR DEVICE DI, check:|1.Input power from Power source|2.Input fuses on each phase
str.desc: A critical Input Power fault has been detected on POWER_MONITOR_DEVICE DI, check input power from Power source.

str.text: A critical fault has been detected, the system may require service. The system has detected %1 on the power supply modules when the modules were disabled. A user with an ADMIN or TECHNICIAN security level may login and diagnose the issue.
str.desc: System has detected voltage on disabled power supply modules. Critical fault has occurred.%1 = voltage telemetry
